Siberian tigers r my favorite tiger sub species but I rlly don’t like this edit😓😓😢 in my defense I stayed up late doing this sk if it comes out trash im soso sorry AND ITS FREAKING OFF SYNC UGH OMFG IHML I HATW THJS EDIT ♯ The Siberian tiger, also known as the Amur tiger (Panthera tigris altaica), is recognized as the world's largest wild cat subspecies. Native primarily to the snowy boreal forests of the Russian Far East and parts of northeastern China, adult males can grow up to 10–12 feet in length and weigh over 600 pounds, while females are noticeably smaller. They are uniquely adapted to extreme cold, featuring a dense, pale orange coat with fewer and wider stripes, a thick layer of belly fat, and shaggy winter fur. As solitary apex predators, their diet consists mainly of wild boar, elk, and deer, and they can consume up to 60 pounds of meat in a single meal. Although their numbers dropped critically low in the 20th century due to poaching and habitat loss, dedicated conservation efforts have helped stabilize wild populations to roughly 500 to 600 individuals, keeping them listed as endangered. #tiger #tigeredit #tigercat #siberiantiger #amurtiger
